reviews.text: Very understanding staff especially as we had to cancel at the last minute.

Very caring staff.
Friendly and clean .
I take all my animals here and they are fantastic with them
2 ten minute calls trying to get hold of  somebody. No reply. Total waste of time.  Tried Thornbury,but they couldn't help. They said there was definitely a receptionist, but no vets.

If you want proper advise and care for your pets please DO NOT use YORKSHIRE VETS at MEANWOOD, they will mislead you with the diagnosis on purpose, then charge you for diagnostic tests that are not required . On one occasion,  through our persistence in asking for a senior vet to review the first diagnosis and planned treatment, is the only reason our dog is still alive today.
PLEASE FIND ANOTHER VETS PRACTICE IF YOU TRULY CARE FOR YOU PETS.

Yorkshire Vets Meanwood saved the day! We were travelling for a weekend away with our elderly pupper and had forgotten his meds, our vets emailed medical records and Meanwood sorted us out for the weekend so we didn't have to turn back in 35 degree heat. The staff were fab and so kind to my little Grumbledore! Thanks a million!
Always professional, friendly and informative. Would highly recommend. Good booking system too.
The reception staff have been super supportive and extremely kind when sorting out a difficult issue with a stray cat. Thank you so much for making a stressful time less so.
Excellent service and advice regarding Thomas weight management. Very friendly staff. Would highly recommend Yorkshire vets to all pet owners.Outstanding. 👍 …
Staff are excellent, so friendly and caring
Everyone working there is lovely and always try to make my nervous dog at ease

Some lovely nurses, but difficult to rebook appts as rotas not done a month in advance.
Tiny wait room, squashed receptionists, noisy, stresses my cat out before she sees vet/vet nurse as often 2/3 dogs in the tiny waiting room area.
Beware pet club, benefits getting slowly eroded, just this month reduced discount on long term medications from 20% to 10% so bill rose £6 to £103! Charge £45 a month for a vet nurse to give an Injection. Not including cost of the injection itself! Absolute rip off.
Roll on govt investigation into vet fees & lack of transparency. Will shortly be moving to another vet this time an independent one, not one run by a big company.
Really friendly, relaxed atmosphere. Great service. Well informed and all questions answered.
Vets are good, staff are warm and inviting. Skye gets the treatment that she needs.
Such a friendly and supportive practice - really care about our pets and have a wealth of knowledge too 😊 …
All the staff are very welcoming and helpful. My appointments are always on time and met with friendly vet staff every time.
Just spent £56 on three travel sickness tablets and no veterinary assistance available there that day…

The staff were friendly, but the prices were outrageous. £62 for a 10-minute consultation, followed by an additional £80+ for antibiotics for my cat. It honestly felt more like a cash grab than a genuine effort to provide value for money. The focus seems to be on how much they could charge rather than delivering a fair service.
Been going here years very professional and polite they always put the animals well-being first highly recommended thank you
Friendly staff always welcoming very accommodating it's local to where I live 🙂 …
Love our local vet practice in Meanwood. They genuinely care about the animals they treat.
Kind, friendly and relaxed atmosphere. Always delt with on time & in a professional manner. Felt I could chat to the vet and I wasn't rushed.
Informative, professional caring people

Extreme difficulty in getting hold of anyone by phone to order a repeat prescription for my cat. I left a message as directed (twice) but no response. When I called into the practice in person I was made to wait for half an hour - and then charged £31 for the prescription - up from the £28 I paid 3 months previously. I order the medicine online because it saves over a third of the cost compared with buying from the practice.

Practice also looks tired and long overdue for a coat of paint and a refurb. Looks like the owners (based in Bristol) are cutting back on service and taking max profits.

Never seem to answer phones or reply to emails. Closest vet to me so I have no other options as I don't drive. Recently had bad experience with a vet I've never seen before being too rough with my dog and releasing to me when he was still heavily sedated. Never had an issue with the usual vet and have used them for about 20 years. No wheelchair access as there's a high step to go in and a narrow doorway. Lots of parking available.
Very good vets, caring and excellent service.
Clean and friendly place.  However,  I would like to know why i was charged over £40 for Isathal cat eye drops 10mg when they cost only £10.60 on Amazon for the exact same? …
Got an appointment really quickly. Very efficient and friendly staff
